extracted.intended_audience: regulators, agency staff, attorneys, policy stakeholders, and public commenters who track or respond to federal proposed rules
extracted.subtask_description: An index/listing of U.S. Federal Register documents of type 'Proposed Rule' published in 2021, each with title, abstract, agency, and links. Useful for finding rulemakings, their summaries, and procedural points (e.g., hearings, requests for comment, proposed regulatory changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for law student and business-employee representation before the Copyright Claims Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish procedures governing the appearance of law student representatives and employees of business entities in proceedings before the Copyright Claims Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notice of proposed rulemaking to create procedures for appearances by law students and by employees of business entities in CCB proceedings; details and limitations would be set out in the proposed rules (see full NPRM).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public hearing announcement for EPA aircraft engine PM standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Announce and hold a virtual public hearing on proposed particulate matter (PM) emission standards for aircraft engines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The EPA scheduled a virtual hearing (date provided) on its proposed PM emission standards for aircraft engines; the announcement explains how stakeholders can participate and provide testimony as part of the notice-and-comment process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of petitions for reconsideration in Commission rulemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for reconsideration (e.g., filed by stakeholders on behalf of associations) may be filed in Commission rulemaking proceedings and are docketed for consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Federal Register entry notifies that a petition for reconsideration was filed and available for review; procedural posture and next steps (e.g., whether the Commission will grant reconsideration) are indicated in the filing notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of transitioning SIP codes for robocall notification (SIP 603 → 607/608)
rubrics_metrics.description: Seek comment on whether and how to transition away from use of SIP Code 603 for immediate notification of call blocking and toward SIP Codes 607 and 608, including costs/benefits and burdens on small businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FCC requests comment on technical transition approaches, potential costs and benefits of phasing out SIP Code 603 for immediate notification, and the burdens (if any) on small businesses; commenters should address economic impacts and implementation feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensions of comment and reply deadlines in rulemaking dockets
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant or deny motions to extend public comment and reply comment deadlines for pending NPRMs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Commission may extend deadlines for comments and reply comments in a proceeding (e.g., Updating FM Broadcast Radio Service Directional Antenna Performance Verification); notice describes the motion and the new deadlines when granted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of RNAV route (T-364) in vicinity of Kotzebue, AK
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to establish United States Area Navigation (RNAV) route T-364 in the vicinity of Kotzebue, AK to support T-route modernization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAA proposes route establishment as part of a broader T-route modernization project; the NPRM includes proposed route descriptions, airspace and procedural considerations, and invites comment on safety and operational impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of RNAV route (T-269) in vicinity of Yakutat, AK
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend United States Area Navigation (RNAV) route T-269 in the vicinity of Yakutat, AK in support of T-route modernization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposed amendment provides updated routing details and rationale tied to modernization; commenters can address navigation safety, charting, and local impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of petition to update petroleum-equivalence factor for EVs (CAFE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request public comment on a petition asking DOE to update its regulations for calculating a petroleum-equivalent fuel economy value for electric vehicles for use in the CAFE program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document summarizes substantive aspects of the petition from NRDC and Sierra Club and requests comments on merits; commenters should address technical methodology, policy implications, and effects on CAFE compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airworthiness directive: GE CF34-8C/-8E turbofan engines inspections and replacements
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose superseding AD 2019-22-05 to require initial and repetitive inspections of OBV fuel tubes, OBV bleed air manifold link rod assemblies, and OBV fuel fittings, and replacement of OBVs or related hardware that fail inspection; require replacement of certain OBVs as terminating action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAA's NPRM identifies an unsafe condition, explains required inspection intervals and corrective actions, and proposes incorporation of terminating hardware replacements; comments should address compliance burdens, safety justification, and alternative corrective actions if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of RNAV route (T-278) in vicinity of Sisters Island, AK
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend United States Area Navigation (RNAV) route T-278 in the vicinity of Sisters Island, AK as part of T-route modernization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAA proposes specific routing changes and rationale; the NPRM invites comments on the proposed change's navigational and operational consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory electronic submission through Additional Protocol Reporting System (APRS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend Additional Protocol Regulations to require online reporting and document submission through APRS, require registration and maintenance of current APRS account information, and to update/clarify related requirements and definitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The BIS proposes replacing manual reporting with mandatory APRS submissions so all persons/locations subject to APR must register, submit reports via APRS, and maintain account info; also proposes to remove obsolete Initial Report provisions, replace Amended Report provisions, and revise certain definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing to amend food additive regulations to permit vitamin D2 inactive baker's yeast
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice that a petition was filed proposing amendment of food additive regulations to allow safe use of heat-killed (inactive) baker's yeast as a source of vitamin D2 in specified food categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA announced receipt and summarized the petition (from Lallemand Inc.) proposing specified uses and safety considerations; commenters may submit data or objections related to safety, labeling, and usage limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjustments to Schedule of Fees for Consular Services based on Cost of Service Model
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose adjustments to consular service fees (nonimmigrant visas, Border Crossing Card, J-Waiver fee) to better align fees with the costs of providing services based on CoSM findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Department of State proposes fee changes prompted by an updated Cost of Service Model to ensure fees recover the cost of services; the NPRM explains methodology and solicits comment on fee levels and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced Competition Incentive Program for spectrum partitioning/disaggregation/leasing
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose an Enhanced Competition Incentive Program encouraging licensees to offer opportunities for small carriers, Tribal Nations, and rural-serving entities to obtain spectrum via lease, partition, or disaggregation; seek comment on incentives, waste/fraud/abuse protections, alternative construction benchmarks, and reaggregation flexibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FCC's Further Notice seeks input on program design, incentive structures, anti-abuse safeguards, proposed construction benchmarks for licensees, and whether to allow reaggregation flexibility; commenters should address competitiveness, implementation complexity, and potential for gaming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation requirements and timeline for the Affordable Connectivity Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Seek comment on the requirements for implementing the Affordable Connectivity Program and a timeline for rapid implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Wireline Competition Bureau requests input on program requirements, eligibility, timelines, operational steps, and implementation challenges to accelerate program rollout.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Implementation Plan (SIP) Serious Area requirements for 2012 annual PM2.5 NAAQS
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to approve portions of California SIP revisions addressing Serious area requirements for the 2012 annual PM2.5 NAAQS including emissions inventories, best available control measures, demonstrations of attainment and reasonable further progress, quantitative milestones, and motor vehicle emission budgets, while proposing disapproval of certain contingency provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA explains which SIP elements satisfy statutory criteria and which may not (e.g., contingency measures for residential wood burning); the NPRM notes possible reconsideration if new information or public comments indicate statutory criteria are not met and solicits comments on the SIP completeness and appropriateness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airworthiness directive: Rolls-Royce Trent engine IPC shaft inspections and corrective actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to supersede AD 2020-20-07 to continue initial and repetitive borescope or visual inspections of the IPC shaft assembly and require replacement if cracks found, while allowing modification per manufacturer service information as a terminating action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAA's NPRM describes inspection methods, affected models, and options for terminating repetitive inspections via approved modifications (including incorporation by reference of EASA AD or service information); comments may address cost, practicality, and safety margins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airworthiness directive: Pratt & Whitney 1st-stage LPC blade inspections (TAI and UT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to supersede previous ADs and require initial and repetitive ultrasonic testing (UT) inspections and thermal acoustic image (TAI) inspections for cracks in certain 1st-stage low-pressure compressor blades and removal of blades that fail inspection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAA explains the unsafe condition prompting added inspection methods (UT in addition to TAI), inspection intervals, and required corrective actions (blade removal); the NPRM invites comment on inspection feasibility and compliance burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend and revoke Class E airspace; update airport geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend and revoke certain Class E airspace designations (e.g., at Grove, OK) and to update airport geographic coordinates to align with FAA aeronautical database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAA's NPRM provides proposed airspace descriptions, reasons tied to VOR decommissioning and MON program, and invites comment on safety, charting, and local navigation impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update access authorization fees and administrative regulatory changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend NRC regulations to update access authorization fees to recover full costs, revise definitions to include new naming conventions for background investigation case types, and specify the electronic process for completing security forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The NRC's proposed fee changes are prompted by an external audit and reflect increased review time per application; NPRM explains fee calculation, proposed definitions changes, and transition to electronic completion processes for security forms, soliciting comment on fee fairness and implementation.
